title: Global high-resolution estimates of the U.N. Human Development Index using satellite imagery and machine learning
Using markets to adapt to climate change
Accounting for unobservable heterogeneity in cross section using spatial first differences
abstract: We develop a cross-sectional research design to identify causal effects in the presence of unobservable heterogeneity without instruments. When units are dense in physical space, it may be sufficient to regress the "spatial first differences" (SFD) of the outcome on the treatment and omit all covariates. The identifying assumptions of SFD are similar in mathematical structure and plausibility to other quasi-experimental designs. We use SFD to obtain new estimates for the effects of time-invariant geographic factors, soil and climate, on long-run agricultural productivities --- relationships crucial for economic decisions, such as land management and climate policy, but notoriously confounded by unobservables.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种横截面研究设计，在不使用工具变量的情况下，识别存在不可观测异质性时的因果效应。当研究单位在物理空间中分布密集时，可能只需将结果变量的“空间一阶差分”（SFD）对处理变量进行回归，并省略所有协变量即可。SFD的识别假设在数学结构和合理性上，与其他准实验设计相似。我们运用SFD，获得了随时间不变的地理因素（土壤和气候）对长期农业生产率影响的新估计。这些关系对于土地管理和气候政策等经济决策至关重要，但众所周知，它们容易受到不可观测因素的混淆。

title: A machine learning pipeline for merging and georeferencing very large archives of historical aerial photographs
venue: IEEE International Conference on Big Data

title: Machine learning predicts which rivers, streams, and wetlands the Clean Water Act regulates
abstract: We assess which waters the Clean Water Act protects and how Supreme Court and White House rules change this regulation. We train a deep learning model using aerial imagery and geophysical data to predict 150,000 jurisdictional determinations from the Army Corps of Engineers, each deciding regulation for one water resource. Under a 2006 Supreme Court ruling, the Clean Water Act protects two-thirds of US streams and more than half of wetlands; under a 2020 White House rule, it protects less than half of streams and a fourth of wetlands, implying deregulation of 690,000 stream miles, 35 million wetland acres, and 30% of waters around drinking-water sources. Our framework can support permitting, policy design, and use of machine learning in regulatory implementation problems.
abstract_zh: 我们评估了《清洁水法》保护哪些水体，以及最高法院裁决和白宫规则如何改变这一监管。我们利用航拍影像和地球物理数据训练了一个深度学习模型，以预测美国陆军工程兵团作出的15万份管辖权认定，每份认定都决定了对一处水资源的监管。根据2006年最高法院的裁决，《清洁水法》保护美国三分之二的溪流和一半以上的湿地；根据2020年白宫规则，它保护的溪流不足一半，湿地仅占四分之一，这意味着将放松管制69万英里溪流、3500万英亩湿地，以及饮用水源周边30%的水体。我们的框架可以支持许可审批、政策设计，以及机器学习在监管执行问题中的应用。

title: Removing development incentives in risky areas promotes climate adaptation
abstract: As natural disasters grow in frequency and intensity with climate change, limiting the populations and properties in harm’s way will be key to adaptation. This study evaluates one approach to discouraging development in risky areas—eliminating public incentives for development, such as infrastructure investments, disaster assistance and federal flood insurance. Using machine learning and matching techniques, we examine the Coastal Barrier Resources System (CBRS), a set of lands where these federal incentives have been removed. We find that the policy leads to lower development densities inside designated areas, increases development in neighbouring areas, reduces flood damages and alters local demographics. Our results suggest that the CBRS generates substantial savings for the federal government by reducing flood claims in the National Flood Insurance Program, while increasing the property tax base in coastal counties.
abstract_zh: 随着气候变化导致自然灾害的频率和强度不断增加，限制处于危险之中的人口和财产，将是适应气候变化的关键。本研究评估了一种抑制风险地区开发的方法，即取消政府对开发的公共激励，例如基础设施投资、灾害援助和联邦洪水保险。我们运用机器学习和匹配技术，考察了沿海屏障资源系统（CBRS），这是一组已取消上述联邦激励措施的土地。我们发现，该政策导致指定区域内的开发密度降低，同时增加了邻近地区的开发，减少了洪水损失，并改变了当地的人口结构。我们的结果表明，CBRS通过减少国家洪水保险计划中的洪水索赔，为联邦政府节省了大量资金，同时增加了沿海县的房产税基。

title: Accounting for ecosystem service values in climate policy
abstract: Ecosystem services are often omitted from climate policies due to difficulties in estimating the economic value of climate-driven ecosystem changes. However, recent advancements in data and methods can help us overcome these challenges and move towards a more comprehensive accounting of climate impacts.
abstract_zh: 由于难以估算气候驱动的生态系统变化的经济价值，生态系统服务常常被排除在气候政策之外。然而，数据和方法的最新进展有助于我们克服这些挑战，并朝着更全面地核算气候影响的方向迈进。

title: Wetlands, flooding, and the Clean Water Act
abstract: In 2020 the Environmental Protection Agency narrowed the definition of “waters of the United States,” significantly limiting wetland protection under the Clean Water Act. Current policy debates center on the uncertainty around wetland benefits. We estimate the value of wet-lands for flood mitigation across the United States using detailed flood claims and land use data. We find the average hectare of wetland lost between 2001 and 2016 cost society $1,840 annually, and over $8,000 in developed areas. We document significant spatial heterogeneity in wetland benefits, with implications for flood insurance policy and the 50 percent of “isolated ” wetlands at risk of losing federal protection. (JEL K32, Q24, Q25, Q53, Q58)
abstract_zh: 2020年，美国环境保护署缩小了“美国水域”的定义，从而大幅限制了《清洁水法》下的湿地保护。当前的政策争论集中于湿地效益的不确定性。我们利用详细的洪灾理赔数据和土地利用数据，估算了湿地在全美洪水减缓方面的价值。我们发现，2001至2016年间每公顷湿地的损失每年给社会造成1,840美元的成本，而在开发区域则超过8,000美元。我们记录了湿地效益存在显著的空间异质性，这对洪水保险政策以及面临失去联邦保护风险的50%“孤立”湿地具有重要意义。（JEL K32, Q24, Q25, Q53, Q58）

title: The effect of large-scale anti-contagion policies on the COVID-19 pandemic
abstract: Governments around the world are responding to the coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic with unprecedented policies designed to slow the growth rate of infections. Many policies, such as closing schools and restricting populations to their homes, impose large and visible costs on society; however, their benefits cannot be directly observed and are currently understood only through process-based simulations. Here we compile data on 1,700 local, regional and national non-pharmaceutical interventions that were deployed in the ongoing pandemic across localities in China, South Korea, Italy, Iran, France and the United States. We then apply reduced-form econometric methods, commonly used to measure the effect of policies on economic growth to empirically evaluate the effect that these anti-contagion policies have had on the growth rate of infections.

title: Estimating an economic and social value of forests: Evidence from tree mortality in the American West
abstract: Linkages between healthy forests and human well-being are often theorized, yet the magnitude of benefits remains unknown. This paper uses a natural experiment to assess the welfare consequences of changes in forest health across the American West. My empirical analysis relies on plausibly random variation in tree mortality generated by the thermal threshold at which cold-induced mortality occurs in bark beetles. I find that forest die-off has significant and economically meaningful impacts on both the market value of forests and the non-market benefits these ecosystems provide. I estimate that over the last two decades, tree mortality in the American West decreased the value of timber tracts by $1.1 billion, decreased home values by $16.5 billion, and increased damages from air pollution, wildfire, and floods by a combined $921 million. In a back-of-the-envelope calculation, I find that the death of a tree in my sample costs society $43 in foregone benefits
abstract_zh: 健康的森林与人类福祉之间的联系常被理论化，但其收益的大小仍不为人知。本文利用一项自然实验，评估美国西部森林健康变化的福利后果。我的实证分析依赖于树木死亡率中看似随机的变化，这种变化源于树皮甲虫因低温导致死亡的温度阈值。我发现，森林的大面积枯死对森林的市场价值以及这些生态系统所提供的非市场效益，均产生了显著且具有经济意义的影响。我估计，在过去二十年间，美国西部的树木死亡使林地的木材价值减少了11亿美元，使房屋价值减少了165亿美元，并使空气污染、野火和洪水造成的损失合计增加了9.21亿美元。通过粗略估算，我发现样本中一棵树的死亡使社会损失了43美元的收益

title: A postcolonial land cover transition in the Caribbean
abstract: Many of the most consequential changes in land cover predate modern satellite imagery and thus remain poorly understood. In particular, few studies have documented how societies restructured their use of land as they transitioned from colonial rule, under which distant governments strongly influenced decisions about local resources, to self-governance. Here, we conduct the first analysis of land cover changes at scale across eight Caribbean island nations and territories between the mid-twentieth century, before or as they transitioned to self-governance, to the present. Our analysis is made possible by transforming 6,136 historical aerial photographs into the first national remotely-sensed land cover record extending to the colonial era. To our knowledge, this is the largest single application of historical aerial photography in the scientific literature, exceeding the scale of prior efforts by more than an order of magnitude. These data reveal how the spatial footprint of an extractive colonial economy gradually dissolves. We find that agricultural use declined substantially under self-governance, falling 35% over ~60 years. 90% of former farmland returned to natural cover, a pattern that contrasts with the satellite-era narrative of tropical forest loss. At fine spatial scale, we find evidence that this retreat partly reflects a gradual transition of agricultural land away from sugar, the prevailing colonial export crop, and towards local staples. In particular, sugar-suited farmland disappears disproportionately where hurricanes have occurred, suggesting that inherited colonial-era plantation capital is not rebuilt when destroyed. These results illuminate how societies reorganize their use of land when they govern themselves.
abstract_zh: 许多影响最为深远的土地覆被变化早于现代卫星影像出现，因此仍然鲜为人知。尤其是，很少有研究记录了社会在从殖民统治（即遥远的政府强烈影响当地资源决策）向自治的转变过程中，如何重组其土地利用方式。在此，我们首次对加勒比地区八个岛国和地区，从20世纪中叶（在其走向自治之前或同时）至今的土地覆被变化进行了大规模分析。我们将6136张历史航空照片转化为首个可追溯至殖民时代的全国性遥感土地覆被记录，使这一分析成为可能。据我们所知，这是科学文献中历史航空摄影规模最大的单项应用，其规模比以往的工作高出一个数量级以上。这些数据揭示了以采掘为主的殖民经济的空间足迹是如何逐渐消散的。我们发现，在自治条件下，农业用地大幅减少，约60年间下降了35%。90%的原农田重新转变为自然植被，这一模式与卫星时代关于热带森林损失的叙述形成对比。在精细的空间尺度上，我们发现有证据表明，这种撤退在一定程度上反映了农业用地逐渐从殖民时期的主要出口作物甘蔗转向当地的主粮作物。特别是，适宜种植甘蔗的农田在遭受飓风的地区消失得尤为明显，这表明继承下来的殖民时期种植园资本在被摧毁后并未得到重建。这些结果阐明了社会在实现自我治理后，如何重新组织其土地利用。

title: Buyer aversion to flood resistant homes
abstract: We investigate the ``adaptation puzzle" — why homeowners under-invest in climate resilience — through the lens of flood-resistant building codes. Linking data on community-level flood code adoption with insurance claims and real estate transactions, we find that elevating a home one foot reduces flood damages by 0.83% of the property's value, yet reduces its sale price by 1.7%. While the financial benefits of lower flood risk fully capitalize into home values, they are outweighed by non-financial costs like inconvenience or aesthetics. Lack of adoption may thus be economically rational. Our findings underscore the challenges of adapting capital assets to natural disaster risks.
abstract_zh: 我们通过防洪建筑规范的视角，探讨“适应之谜”，即为什么房主在气候韧性方面投资不足。通过将社区层面的防洪规范采纳数据与保险理赔和房地产交易数据相联系，我们发现，将房屋抬高一英尺可使洪水损失减少相当于房产价值0.83%的金额，但会使其售价降低1.7%。尽管较低洪水风险带来的经济收益完全资本化进房价之中，但它们仍被诸如不便或美观等非经济成本所抵消。因此，缺乏采纳行为在经济上可能是理性的。我们的研究结果凸显了使资本资产适应自然灾害风险所面临的挑战。

title: Cooling where it counts: A framework for targeting urban heat mitigation investments
abstract: As urban areas warm, where should cooling interventions be deployed to maximize health benefits? This question is critical for cities like Los Angeles, where rising heat, socioeconomic disparities, and uneven adaptive capacity converge. We present a spatially explicit framework that integrates urban heat burden, population vulnerability, and intervention feasibility using income and age stratified temperature–mortality response functions to guide the deployment of urban cooling measures such as reflective coatings. We show that reflective coatings could reduce mean air temperatures in Los Angeles by ~1 degree C in the top 2% of study area and lower heat-related mortality by 48% if deployed citywide. Benefits are highly concentrated: 50% of avoidable deaths can be prevented by treating just 9% of urban paintable surface area, which enables targeted deployment. An interactive web portal translates these findings for local decision-making, offering a replicable pathway for spatially optimized heat adaptation in other cities worldwide.
abstract_zh: 随着城市区域变暖，降温干预措施应部署在何处才能使健康效益最大化？对于洛杉矶这样的城市而言，这一问题至关重要，因为那里的气温上升、社会经济差距和不均衡的适应能力交织在一起。我们提出了一个具有空间明确性的框架，该框架整合了城市热负担、人口脆弱性和干预可行性，并利用按收入和年龄分层的温度—死亡率响应函数，以指导诸如反射涂层等城市降温措施的部署。我们表明，若在全市范围内部署反射涂层，可使洛杉矶研究区域内最热的2%区域的平均气温降低约1摄氏度，并使与热相关的死亡率降低48%。收益高度集中：仅对9%的城市可涂饰表面积进行处理，即可预防50%的可避免死亡，这使得有针对性的部署成为可能。一个交互式网络门户将这些发现转化为可供地方决策使用的信息，为全球其他城市实现空间优化的热适应提供了可复制的路径。

title: Opportunities for increasing the environmental justice impact of earth observations
venue: Resources for the Future Working Paper
abstract: Environmental justice is an important social priority and has become a policy goal at the federal level. Executive Order 14008, Tackling the Climate Crisis at Home and Abroad, requires all federal agencies to develop programs, policies, and activities to address the disproportionately high adverse environmental impacts faced by marginalized communities. This raises the question of how NASA can increase the impact of its scientific outputs along EJ dimensions. How can the agency’s existing data products be leveraged to enable progress on EJ-related questions? What new scientific information can NASA produce to help reduce environmental inequities? Produced as part of the VALUABLES Consortium, this paper aims to outline ways that NASA can use its data products to promote EJ and overcome the barriers faced in the use of satellite data to influence decisionmaking.
abstract_zh: 环境正义是一项重要的社会优先事项，并已成为联邦层面的政策目标。第14008号行政令《在国内外应对气候危机》要求所有联邦机构制定计划、政策和活动，以应对边缘化社区所面临的不成比例的高环境不利影响。这引出了一个问题：美国国家航空航天局（NASA）如何能够在环境正义维度上提升其科学产出的影响力？如何利用该机构现有的数据产品来推进与环境正义相关的问题研究？NASA又能生产哪些新的科学信息，以帮助减少环境不平等？作为VALUABLES联盟的成果之一，本文旨在概述NASA如何利用其数据产品促进环境正义，并克服在利用卫星数据影响决策过程中所面临的障碍。

title: Paving the Swamp: Consequences of Land Use Regulation Under the Clean Water Act
abstract: How does environmental regulation of land use affect the environment and the economy? We study recent changes to U.S. Clean Water Act regulation, measured using wetland maps and machine learning. Four findings emerge. First, a 2020 White House rule reduced the average non-residential property’s probability of being regulated under the Clean Water Act by about 40 percent. Second, by deregulating wetlands, this rule increased the value of U.S. non-residential properties by about 1%, with larger effects for properties facing greater deregulation and near-zero effects for residential properties. Third, remote sensing indicates that deregulation expanded impervious surfaces like pavement and reduced wetland area. Fourth, the deregulation increased non-residential land values by over $50 billion, which exceeds the estimated loss in the present discounted value of wetlands’ flood mitigation services; we carefully discuss welfare implications.
abstract_zh: 土地利用的环境监管如何影响环境与经济？我们利用湿地地图和机器学习方法，研究了美国《清洁水法》监管的近期变化。我们得出四项发现。第一，2020年白宫的一项规则使非住宅物业被《清洁水法》监管的概率平均下降了约40%。第二，通过放松对湿地的管制，该规则使美国非住宅物业价值提高了约1%，对于面临更大程度放松管制的物业，效果更为明显，而对住宅物业的影响接近于零。第三，遥感数据表明，放松管制扩大了柏油路等不透水地表的面积，并减少了湿地面积。第四，放松管制使非住宅用地价值增加了超过500亿美元，这一数额超过了湿地洪水调节服务现值的估计损失；我们对福利影响进行了审慎讨论。
